GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Good night
   C. Thank you
   D. Good day / hello

2. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.

3. When practising Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.

4. When practising Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Imitative speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative speaking.

5. When practising Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Comprehension.

6. When practising Guided writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided writing.

7. When practising Listening for gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist.

8. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.

9. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Haus
   C. Wasser
   D. Buch

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
